about: SN120 token caps: the ONE canonical source, published at https://affine.io/caps.json (repo: caps.json, loader caps.py). Edit max_output_tokens here, then run tools/caps/caps_apply.py (see tools/caps/README.md). Every other cap value (generation, batch files, training, gate, probe, prior sampler, miner kit, llms.txt, mining.json) is derived from this file and checked against it by tools/caps/caps_check.py.
